title: alocacao-uti-web: simulation code, configuration files and replication outputs for multi-unit ICU admission rules
description: Continuous-time discrete-event simulation and retrospective time-indexed linear programming benchmarks for multi-type ICU bed allocation under resource scarcity, calibrated with DATASUS/CNES bed capacities (HU-UFMA) and AMIB/Epimed Brazilian ICU registry targets. In the code, the CMU-DL rule is labeled AUSTERE.

creators.name: Carvalho, João Augusto Ferreira Nunes de
